notes.title: New trailer debut @ MIX Fall Showcase - Release Information Soon
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hey all, happy to announce we recently released a [b]new trailer[/b] in partnership with the MIX for their Fall Showcase. This shorter form trailer shows off more about the game's world and [b]the depths that await poor Polly[/b]. It's available to view below:[/p][previewyoutube="DBK0nrqGDm8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We're also happy to announce that [b]the game is scheduled to release [i]this fall[/i].[/b] We will be back soon soon with a more specific release date - things are likely [b]closer than you think[/b]! notes.title: New trailer up - see more of Polly's underworld and a window for release!
notes.notes:
[i]Silly Polly. Stupid, silly Polly - you've ruined everything. Want a cracker?[/i]

Hey all, a quick heads up that a brand new trailer - originally premiered as part of the kick-off to the Summer of Gaming events in The MIX Summer Game Showcase - is now available on the Steam page! It's also available to view at the link below:

[previewyoutube=Vm9mVFVV1aU;full][/previewyoutube]

The new trailer dives into Polly's dark and twisted underworld, and explores some of the game's environments, opponents, and machinations of the "Fog" covered abyss. It also covers game mechanics that you can expect to enjoy when the game launches, such as skateboarding, puzzles, and shifting-perspective action.

SILLY POLLY BEAST is the tale of a girl with nothing, who is forced to face the abyss in her journey to recover the one single thing that means something to her - Alice. The game is expected to release in the fall of 2025.
